blocks.text: 3-darsda Present Continuous ni o'rgandik: I **am working** — hozir ishlayapman. **Past Continuous** (o'tgan davomli zamon) — xuddi shu tuzilma, faqat o'tmishda: **am / is / are** o'rniga **was / were** keladi. I **was working** — ishlayotgan edim. O'zbekchada unga «**-yotgan edi**» («-yotgandi») mos keladi: o'qi**yotgan edim**, uxla**yotgan edik**. Bu zamon o'tmishdagi aniq bir lahzada harakat **boshlangan, lekin hali tugamagan** bo'lganini ko'rsatadi — o'sha lahzaning «surati».

Qachon ishlatiladi: o'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda harakat davom etayotgan bo'lsa — at eight o'clock, at midnight, this time yesterday, at that moment. Masalan, «Kecha soat 8 da nonushta qilayotgan edim» — nonushta 7:45 da boshlangan, 8:15 da tugagan, soat 8 esa uning o'rtasiga to'g'ri kelgan: I **was having** breakfast at 8.

items.text: At eight o'clock I **was having** breakfast.
This time yesterday we **were flying** to London.
items.translation: Kecha shu paytda Londonga **uchib ketayotgan edik**.
Yarim tunda chaqaloq hali ham **yig'layotgan edi**.

blocks.text: Inkor va savol be fe'li orqali yasaladi (10-darsdagidek), did kerak emas: inkor — **wasn't / weren't** + `-ing`; savol — **Was / Were** + ega + `-ing`? Qisqa javob: Yes, I **was**. / No, they **weren't**. Eng ko'p beriladigan savol: **What were you doing?** — «Nima qilayotgan edingiz?»

items.text: **Was** it **raining** at the weekend? — No, it **wasn't**.
items.translation: Dam olish kunlari **yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edimi**? — Yo'q.

blocks.text: Past Simple va Past Continuous: butun harakat va jarayon

Ikkala zamon ham o'tmish haqida, lekin harakatga turli tomondan qaraydi. **Past Simple** — harakat butunligicha: boshlandi va tugadi (I **had** breakfast at 8 — sakkizda nonushta qildim, ya'ni shu paytda boshladim). **Past Continuous** — harakatning o'rtasi: o'sha lahzada u davom etayotgan edi (I **was having** breakfast at 8). O'zbekchada ham shu farq bor: «qildim» va «qilayotgan edim». Ikkalasi bitta gapda kelishi — keyingi, 14-darsda.

rows: She **read** a book yesterday. — Kecha kitob o'qidi.
At nine she **was reading** a book. — To'qqizda kitob o'qiyotgan edi.
It **rained** for two hours. — Ikki soat yomg'ir yog'di.
At five it **was raining**. — Beshda yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi.
We **were walking** home at midnight. — Yarim tunda uyga piyoda ketayotgan edik.

blocks.text: Hikoyada fon: The sun was shining ...

Hikoya yoki voqeani aytib berganda Past Continuous vaziyatni, «fon» ni chizadi: ob-havo, atrofdagilar nima qilayotgani. Asosiy voqealar esa Past Simple bilan aytiladi. O'zbekchada bunday fon ko'pincha «-ardi» yoki «-ib turardi» bilan beriladi: The sun **was shining** — Quyosh charaqlab **turardi**.

items.text: It was a cold evening, and snow **was falling**.

blocks.text: `-ing` imlosi 3-darsdagidek: make → mak**ing**, swim → swim**ming**, lie → l**ying**. Continuous da ishlatilmaydigan fe'llar (know, like, want, believe, understand — 8-dars) o'tgan zamonda ham Continuous olmaydi: I **knew** the answer («I was knowing» emas).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I was work at 8.» → I **was working** at 8. (`-ing` shart); «At 8 I working.» → At 8 I **was working**. (was shart); «They was playing.» → They **were** playing.; «I was knowing him.» → I **knew** him.; «What you were doing?» → What **were** you **doing**?; «Did you sleeping?» → **Were** you **sleeping**? (Continuous savoli did bilan emas, was / were bilan).

Past Continuous ni «to'xtatilgan kadr» deb tasavvur qiling: kino to'xtatildi — ekranda kim nima qilayotgan bo'lsa, o'sha **was / were + -ing**. Savol berib tekshiring: «O'sha lahzada harakat hali davom etayotgan edimi?» Ha bo'lsa — Past Continuous.
Ikki harakat birga: I **was walking** home when it **started** to rain; when va while — 14-dars. Present Continuous — 3–4-darslar, was / were — 10-dars.

examples.title: **was / were** + -ing at a time in the past
examples.description: O'tmishdagi aniq paytda davom etayotgan harakat: at seven o'clock, at midnight, at that moment. O'zbekchada — «-yotgan edi».

sentences.text: At seven o'clock this morning I **was having** a shower.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab soat yettida **dush qabul qilayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: Grandma **was cooking** plov at noon.
sentences.translation: Tush paytida buvim **palov pishirayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: We **were watching** the football at nine last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha soat to'qqizda **futbol ko'rayotgan edik**.

sentences.text: At midnight Bekzod **was** still **studying** for his exam.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda Bekzod hali ham imtihonga **tayyorlanayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: At half past ten the children **were sleeping** peacefully.
sentences.translation: Soat o'n yarimda bolalar tinchgina **uxlayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **was working** in the garden, so she didn't hear the phone.
sentences.translation: Sara bog'da **ishlayotgan edi**, shuning uchun telefonni eshitmadi.

sentences.text: In those days my parents **were living** in a small rented flat.
sentences.translation: U paytlarda ota-onam kichkina ijara kvartirada **yashab turishardi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **was talking** to her boss on the phone at that moment.
sentences.translation: O'sha paytda Dilnoza boshlig'i bilan **telefonda gaplashayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: It **was raining** hard at six, and everybody **was hurrying** home.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida kuchli yomg'ir **yog'ayotgan edi**, hamma uyga **shoshilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Tom and James **were travelling** around Scotland last July.
sentences.translation: O'tgan iyulda Tom bilan Jeyms Shotlandiya bo'ylab **sayohat qilayotgan edi**.

examples.title: This time yesterday: everybody **was doing** something
examples.description: O'tmishdagi bitta lahzaning «surati»: o'sha paytda kim nima qilayotgan edi. Bir gapda ikki harakat — and / esa bilan.

sentences.text: This time yesterday I **was sitting** on a plane to Istanbul.
sentences.translation: Kecha shu paytda Istanbulga uchayotgan samolyotda **o'tirgan edim**.

sentences.text: At nine last night my brother **was doing** his homework, and I **was washing** the dishes.
sentences.translation: Kecha soat to'qqizda ukam **uy vazifasini qilayotgan edi**, men esa **idish yuvayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: Mum **was ironing** shirts and Dad **was reading** the newspaper.
sentences.translation: Oyim ko'ylak **dazmollayotgan edi**, dadam esa gazeta **o'qiyotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Outside, some boys **were playing** football in the street.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida bir nechta bola ko'chada **futbol o'ynayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: In the next flat our neighbours **were having** a noisy party.
sentences.translation: Qo'shni kvartirada qo'shnilarimiz shovqinli **ziyofat qilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Our cat **was sleeping** on the sofa as usual.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz odatdagidek divanda **uxlayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Meanwhile, in London, Emma **was getting** ready for work.
sentences.translation: Bu orada Londonda Emma **ishga tayyorlanayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: At the same time Aziz and Madina **were walking** in the park.
sentences.translation: Shu paytda Aziz bilan Madina **parkda sayr qilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Two of my friends **were waiting** for me at the bus stop.
sentences.translation: Ikki do'stim meni bekatda **kutayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Everybody in the house **was doing** something, and nobody **was listening** to Grandad.
sentences.translation: Uydagilarning har biri nimadir **qilayotgan edi**, bobomni esa hech kim **tinglamayotgan edi**.

examples.title: Negative: **wasn't** / **weren't** + -ing
examples.description: Inkor: **wasn't / weren't** + `-ing`. Ko'pincha to'g'ri harakat bilan yonma-yon: weren't doing ..., were playing ... O'zbekchada: «-mayotgan edi», «-yotgani yo'q edi».

sentences.text: I **wasn't sleeping** — I was just resting my eyes.
sentences.translation: **Uxlayotganim yo'q edi** — shunchaki ko'zimni yumib dam olayotgan edim.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **wasn't listening**. Can you say that again?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **quloq solmayotgan edim**. Yana bir bor aytasizmi?

sentences.text: The children **weren't doing** their homework; they **were playing** games.
sentences.translation: Bolalar uy vazifasini **qilayotgani yo'q edi**, **o'yin o'ynayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: We **weren't driving** fast — only forty kilometres an hour.
sentences.translation: Biz **tez haydamayotgan edik** — soatiga atigi qirq kilometr.

sentences.text: It **wasn't raining** in the morning, so I didn't take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Ertalab yomg'ir **yog'mayotgan edi**, shuning uchun soyabon olmadim.

sentences.text: Madina **wasn't wearing** her glasses, so she didn't recognise me.
sentences.translation: Madina **ko'zoynak taqmagan edi**, shuning uchun meni tanimadi.

sentences.text: At that time Tom **wasn't working**; he **was looking** for a job.
sentences.translation: O'sha paytda Tom **ishlamayotgan edi**, ish **qidirayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: My phone **wasn't working** properly, so I took it to a repair shop.
sentences.translation: Telefonim yaxshi **ishlamayotgan edi**, shuning uchun uni ustaxonaga olib bordim.

sentences.text: The students **weren't paying** attention, and the teacher **was getting** angry.
sentences.translation: Talabalar **e'tibor bermayotgan edi**, o'qituvchining esa **jahli chiqayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, you **weren't disturbing** me — I **wasn't doing** anything important.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, meni **bezovta qilmadingiz** — hech qanday muhim ish **qilayotganim yo'q edi**.

examples.title: **Were** you ...ing? — Yes, I **was**. / No, I **wasn't**.
examples.description: Savol: **Was / Were** + ega + `-ing`? (did emas). Qisqa javob: Yes, she **was**. / No, they **weren't**.

sentences.text: **Were** you sleeping at ten? — No, I **wasn't**. I **was reading**.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda **uxlayotgan edingizmi**? — Yo'q, **uxlamayotgan edim**. Kitob **o'qiyotgan edim**.

sentences.text: **Was** it snowing in Tashkent this morning? — Yes, it **was**.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab Toshkentda **qor yog'ayotgan edimi**? — Ha, **yog'ayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: **Was** Aziz wearing a suit at the meeting? — Yes, he **was**, and a tie too.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda Aziz **kostyum kiyganmidi**? — Ha, **kiygan edi**, galstuk ham taqqan edi.

sentences.text: **Were** the kids behaving well at Grandma's? — Yes, they **were**, as always.
sentences.translation: Bolalar buvisinikida **odobli o'tirishdimi**? — Ha, har doimgidek **odobli o'tirishdi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **were** you waiting for me? — Yes, we **were**, but it's OK.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **meni kutayotgan edingizmi**? — Ha, **kutayotgan edik**, lekin hechqisi yo'q.

sentences.text: Emma, **was** your sister crying on the phone? — No, she **was laughing**!
sentences.translation: Emma, singling telefonda **yig'layotgan edimi**? — Yo'q, u **kulayotgan edi**!

sentences.text: **Was** the sun shining in Bukhara yesterday? — Yes, it **was**, all day.
sentences.translation: Kecha Buxoroda **quyosh charaqlab turganmidi**? — Ha, kun bo'yi **charaqlab turdi**.

sentences.text: And **were** your neighbours making a lot of noise again? — No, they **weren't**.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilaringiz yana **shovqin qilayotgan edimi**? — Yo'q, **qilmayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod, **were** you driving fast? — No, I **wasn't**. Only fifty!
sentences.translation: Bekzod, **tez haydayotgan edingmi**? — Yo'q, **tez emas**. Atigi ellikda!

sentences.text: **Were** Tom and Sarah still living in Oxford in 2020? — Yes, they **were**.
sentences.translation: 2020-yilda Tom bilan Sara hali ham **Oksfordda yashashardimi**? — Ha, **yashashardi**.

examples.title: What **were** you **doing**? Where **was** she **going**?
examples.description: So'roq so'zi + **was / were** + ega + `-ing`: What were you doing? Who were you talking to? Where was she going?

sentences.text: What **were** you **doing** at eleven last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha soat o'n birda **nima qilayotgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: Where **was** Madina **going** in such a hurry?
sentences.translation: Madina bunchalik shoshib **qayerga ketayotgan edi**?

sentences.text: Who **were** you **talking** to on the phone?
sentences.translation: Telefonda **kim bilan gaplashayotgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: Why **was** the baby **crying** all night?
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq nega tun bo'yi **yig'lab chiqdi**?

sentences.text: What **was** your father **doing** in London last week?
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta otangiz Londonda **nima qilib yurgan edi**?

sentences.text: Where **were** you **sitting** at the concert? — In the third row.
sentences.translation: Konsertda **qayerda o'tirgan edingiz**? — Uchinchi qatorda.

sentences.text: What **were** the students **laughing** at?
sentences.translation: Talabalar **nimaga kulayotgan edi**?

sentences.text: How fast **was** the car **going**? — About a hundred.
sentences.translation: Mashina **qanchalik tez ketayotgan edi**? — Taxminan yuzda.

sentences.text: Tom, why **were** you **standing** outside in the rain?
sentences.translation: Tom, nega yomg'irda tashqarida **turgan eding**?

sentences.text: When you saw James, what **was** he **wearing**?
sentences.translation: Jeymsni ko'rganingizda u **nima kiygan edi**?

examples.title: Setting the scene: the sun **was shining** ...
examples.description: Hikoyada fon: ob-havo va atrofda nima bo'layotgani. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-ardi», «-ib turardi», «-yotgan edi».

sentences.text: It was a lovely spring morning, and the sun **was shining**.
sentences.translation: Bahorning go'zal tongi edi, quyosh **charaqlab turardi**.

sentences.text: Birds **were singing** in the trees outside my window.
sentences.translation: Derazam ortidagi daraxtlarda qushlar **sayrardi**.

sentences.text: In the kitchen my mother **was making** breakfast and **singing** quietly.
sentences.translation: Oshxonada oyim nonushta **tayyorlab**, sekingina **qo'shiq aytayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: The streets of the old city **were getting** busy.
sentences.translation: Eski shahar ko'chalari **gavjumlashib borardi**.

sentences.text: A cold wind **was blowing** from the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog' tomondan sovuq shamol **esayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: People **were hurrying** to work with umbrellas in their hands.
sentences.translation: Odamlar qo'llarida soyabon bilan ishga **shoshilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: On the bus everybody **was looking** at their phones.
sentences.translation: Avtobusda hamma **telefoniga tikilib o'tirardi**.

sentences.text: Outside the café two old men **were playing** chess and **drinking** tea.
sentences.translation: Kafe oldida ikki chol **shaxmat o'ynab**, choy **ichib o'tirardi**.

sentences.text: It **was getting** dark, and the lights in the houses **were coming** on.
sentences.translation: **Qorong'i tushayotgan edi**, uylarda chiroqlar **yonayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Everybody **was waiting** for the bride, and the musicians **were** already **playing**.
sentences.translation: Hamma kelinni **kutayotgan edi**, sozandalar esa allaqachon **chalayotgan edi**.

examples.title: I **had** breakfast / I **was having** breakfast
examples.description: Past Simple — butun harakat (boshlandi va tugadi); Past Continuous — o'sha paytda harakatning o'rtasi. Juft gaplarni solishtiring.

sentences.text: At eight I **had** breakfast, and at nine I **left** for work.
sentences.translation: Sakkizda **nonushta qildim**, to'qqizda ishga **jo'nadim**.

sentences.text: At eight I **was** still **having** breakfast, so I was late.
sentences.translation: Sakkizda hali ham **nonushta qilayotgan edim**, shuning uchun kechikdim.

sentences.text: Emma **watched** two films yesterday; at ten she **was watching** the second one.
sentences.translation: Emma kecha ikkita film **ko'rdi**; soat o'nda ikkinchisini **ko'rayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **was writing** an email at eleven, and he **finished** it at half past.
sentences.translation: Aziz soat o'n birda xat **yozayotgan edi**, uni o'n bir yarimda **tugatdi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday it **rained** for three hours.
sentences.translation: Kecha uch soat yomg'ir **yog'di**.

sentences.text: When I looked out of the window, it **was raining**.
sentences.translation: Derazadan qaraganimda yomg'ir **yog'ayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Last summer we **stayed** with friends in Oxford for a week.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda bir hafta Oksfordda do'stlarimiznikida **turdik**.

sentences.text: This time last week we **were staying** with friends in Oxford.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta shu paytda Oksfordda do'stlarimiznikida **turgan edik**.

sentences.text: Sarah **read** the whole book on the plane.
sentences.translation: Sara butun kitobni samolyotda **o'qib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **was reading** on the plane, so she **didn't notice** the man next to her.
sentences.translation: Sara samolyotda kitob **o'qiyotgan edi**, shuning uchun yonidagi odamni **payqamadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: Why didn't you answer the phone?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: What were you doing? — I was driving. Suhbatda Past Continuous va Past Simple birga.

sentences.text: — Bekzod, why didn't you answer the phone? What **were** you **doing**?
sentences.translation: — Bekzod, nega telefonni ko'tarmading? **Nima qilayotgan eding**?

sentences.text: — Sorry, I **was driving** home from work at that time.
sentences.translation: — Kechir, o'sha paytda ishdan uyga **mashina haydab ketayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: — And at nine? **Were** you still **driving**?
sentences.translation: — To'qqizda-chi? Hali ham **mashina haydayotgan edingmi**?

sentences.text: — No, at nine I **was having** dinner with my parents.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, to'qqizda ota-onam bilan **kechki ovqat qilayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: — And my phone **was charging** in the other room, so I didn't hear it.
sentences.translation: — Telefonim esa boshqa xonada **quvvatlanayotgan edi**, shuning uchun eshitmadim.

sentences.text: — Oh, I see. I **was getting** really worried about you!
sentences.translation: — Ha, tushunarli. Men esa sendan rosa **xavotirlana boshlagan edim**!

sentences.text: — Sorry! So why **were** you **calling** me so late?
sentences.translation: — Kechir! Xo'sh, nega bunchalik kech **qo'ng'iroq qilayotgan eding**?

sentences.text: — We **were planning** a surprise party for Aziz, and we needed your help.
sentences.translation: — Aziz uchun kutilmagan ziyofat **rejalashtirayotgan edik**, yordaming kerak edi.

sentences.text: — Oh, great! Who else **was helping** you?
sentences.translation: — Voy, zo'r! Sizlarga yana **kim yordam berayotgan edi**?

sentences.text: — Madina and Tom. They **were making** a list of guests all evening.
sentences.translation: — Madina bilan Tom. Ular kechqurun bo'yi mehmonlar ro'yxatini **tuzib o'tirishdi**.
